strategy_description: NSE large/midcap stocks opening 1-2%+ above/below prior close on above-average volume tend to continue in the gap direction for 1-2 sessions before reversion. 5-min bars, CNC overnight hold. PreviousSessionClose from pkg/strategy/session.go detects gap conditions. TimedExit provides N-day time-stop. PriceExit provides optional SL/TP. Long-only initially. Primary universe: Nifty Midcap liquid (48 instruments); also applicable to large-cap 15 instruments.

marcus.summary: Gap-and-Go receives GO verdict. Edge is behavioral/structural (institutional flow lag on NSE midcap catalyst events), structurally distinct from killed Donchian breakout. Entry on close of second bar (09:20 IST), SL at 0.8x gapPct, TP at 2.0x gapPct, time-stop 150 bars (2 sessions). Default parameters: gapThreshold=1.0%, volumeMultiplier=1.3x. Orientation instrument: NSE:INDHOTEL. Walk-forward gate is primary structural risk (2022 choppy regime); ORB/Gap-and-Go mutual correlation is secondary post-bootstrap risk.
